'''Siqi''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}, [[Huaxu Academy]]. There are two Siqi with different appearances with the exact same name at the Huaxu Academy. Their dialogues implies they're the same person, but make no references of each other.

==Idle (Spectacles)==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Outdoor at night, but they also appear during the day)
:{{DIcon}} Why is it not morning yet...
:{{DIcon}} So sleepy...
:{{DIcon}} No, I'm about to fall asleep...

;(When hit)
:{{DIcon}} Am I awake? Or is this a dream!?
:{{DIcon}} It hurts, but it's effective!
:{{DIcon}} Uh! It's not enough!

;(Indoor during Day, being scolded by their Director)
:{{DIcon}} Director, I'll for sure have the investigation report ready tomorrow!
:{{DIcon}} You'd better hand it in by then... Otherwise not even I can help you!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue (Spectacles)==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Indoor, at Day)
:'''Siqi:''' Ugh, I finally convinced them to extend the report deadline to tomorrow after some serious convincing.
:'''Siqi:''' Hey, you're the Rover, right? Got important business here?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, it's important.
::'''Siqi:''' Wow, that's impressive... You've been given a big responsibility...
:{{DIcon}} No, just wandering.
::'''Siqi:''' That sounds cool... If you're chilling like that, you must have finished everything ages ago.
:'''Siqi:''' Ugh, I can barely get a research report done.
:'''Siqi:''' Honestly, everyone here at the institute is a genius... The pressure working here is insane.
:'''Siqi:''' My stomach... it hurts again, no, I can't afford this now... I still have to finish this report.
----
;(Outside, At Night)
:'''Siqi:''' Zzz... Huh!? What am I doing? No, can't sleep yet!
:{{DIcon}} Are you okay?
:'''Siqi:''' I'm trying to stay awake, enjoying the evening breeze. Otherwise, I'll... zzz..
:{{DIcon}} Hey! Siqi!
:'''Siqi:''' Ah! Did I just nod off again!? Oh no...
:'''Siqi:''' Could you please, like, hit me when I start dozing off?
:{{DIcon}} Is this okay?
:'''Siqi:''' Please!
{{Dialogue End}}
----
==Idle (Blonde)==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Indoor at night, surrounded by other researchers)
:{{DIcon}} Hey, Siqi! This data's for me, right?
:{{DIcon}} Siqi, bro, how do I use this gadget?
:{{DIcon}} Eh? Okay, okay... one at a time...

==Dialogue (Blonde)==
;(Indoor, at Night)
:'''Siqi:''' Ugh... I really wish I could create a clone of myself when things get this hectic.
:{{DIcon}} Splitting myself in half wouldn't be enough.
:'''Siqi:''' I heard Resonators can create clones. I'm so jealous...
:'''Siqi:''' If I could figure that out, my stomachache would be cut in half.
:{{DIcon}} Why not ask for help?
:'''Siqi:''' People will think I'm useless if I ask for help, won't they?
:'''Siqi:''' I'm not as smart as everyone else, so I need to work harder if I want to stand out.
:'''Siqi:''' I'm okay, just need a short break... The real work happens at night.
{{Dialogue End}}
